digest.component_or_area: snapshot entry store and reducer cache
propositions: Snapshot entries documented as immutable are being written to during read operations when the reducer cache (.cache.json) is materialized inside the entry directory
The write_cache function in reducer/_cache.py writes .cache.json inside ticket_dir for snapshot entries accessed through a pinned root, violating the content-addressed immutability premise
Reverify pass fails on entries because reads add .cache.json files after the baseline digest is recorded, causing entries to appear corrupt on subsequent verification
The atomic_write publish mechanism via os.replace masks in-place write hazards that would corrupt shared inodes if the implementation ever switches to direct write operations
